summary: T341 step 1 only, per explicit instruction: de-scaffolded the guest-manager prototype wrap (git diff HEAD -- src/app/screens/guest-manager/ is empty) while keeping the three mechanism files (ScreenChromeService, AppScreenHead/core/directive, private-layout's head-slot rendering), and re-pointed the (a)/(b) registration/change-detection tests at throwaway stub screens instead of the real GuestManager. Committed alone as 34c8a12. The rest of T341's acceptance list (harness, foot slot, route-data keys, overflow audit, per-breakpoint classification, guest-manager migration, phone verification) is explicitly out of scope for this step and untouched — a human must confirm the guest manager in a browser before that work starts.

acceptance.criterion: De-scaffold the spike before building on it — drop the *appScreenHead wrap so guest-manager is untouched again, keep the three mechanism files, re-point the proving tests at the throwaway stub screens the teardown case already uses
acceptance.evidence: `git diff HEAD -- src/app/screens/guest-manager/` prints nothing (verified twice: pre-commit and post-commit, both empty). Mechanism files kept: src/app/core/service/screen-chrome.service.ts, src/app/core/directive/{index.ts,screen-head.directive.ts}, private-layout's ScreenChromeService injection and *ngTemplateOutlet head-slot rendering (src/app/layouts/private-layout/private-layout.ts:20-21,101-103,130-134; private-layout.html:8-11) all unchanged from the pre-de-scaffold spike. screen-chrome-prototype.spec.ts (a)/(b) now route to a throwaway `StubScreenA` (own `count` signal) instead of `@app/screens/guest-manager/guest-manager` — `GuestManager` import removed from the spec entirely (grep confirms no reference to it remains in the file). Test run: `npx ng test --include "src/app/layouts/private-layout/screen-chrome-prototype.spec.ts" --reporters=verbose` → 7/7 passed, including '(a) registers and renders in private-layout's own DOM, not inside <app-stub-screen-a>' and '(b) re-renders when the screen-owned signal changes, with no manual CD nudge in app code'.
